title: ArtCraft — Controllable AI for Artists
excerpt: ArtCraft is the open-source desktop app for generating AI video and images — built for artists who want real control.
content_html:
Capable tools for artists.

ArtCraft builds open source tools for artists. We pride ourselves on freedom of control and expression.

  • Seedance 2.5
  • Nano Banana 2
  • Image to Location
  • 3D Compositing
  • Character Posing
  • Image to 3D Mesh
  • Background Removal
  • 2D Compositing
  • Mixed Assets

01Crafting features

Real footage — captured in ArtCraft

The control that mere words cannot buy.

Text prompting is neat, but artists crave control. Compose the shot yourself — then let the model render it.

Worlds

01

Image to Location

Place virtual actors into physical environments. Establish single-location consistency and film multiple shots in a room without things disappearing.

3D Compositing

02

Build scenes with depth

Use images, backdrops, foreground elements, and props in scenes with real depth. A couple of images blends naturally into a finished composition.

2D Compositing

03

Precise layered control

Combine images, background removal, layers, and simple drawing tools to compose a scene exactly the way you imagined it.

3D Mesh

04

Image to 3D Mesh

Turning images into 3D helps position elements exactingly. Block complex scenes with intentional geometry instead of fighting prompts.

Mixed Assets

05

Mix every kind of asset

Combine image cutouts, worlds, and 3D meshes in one canvas to lay out scenes with precision and intention.

Posing

06

Character Posing

Dynamically pose your characters to nail the precise character, scene, and camera blocking before calling "action".

Cutouts

07

Background Removal

Instantly remove backgrounds from images to create assets for your scenes. Clean, precise, and ready for compositing.

More in the app

08

Launch the studio

Generate, edit, and compose with every model — right in your browser, no install needed.

02Ownership

Free & open source

Stop renting from websites.

ArtCraft is yours to own and keep, forever. No subscriptions needed, no aggregator middleman, no rent payments.

A

Open source

The whole studio is on GitHub. Read it, fork it, make it yours.

View source

B

Yours forever

ArtCraft is yours to own and keep, forever. No rent payments.

C

No middleman

No aggregator between you and the models. Your work stays yours.

03Proof

From the community

Made with ArtCraft.

Free to start · No subscription

Start crafting.

Download the studio, or run it in your browser. Your first renders are minutes away.
